settings.intro: From wireless CarPlay on your factory screen to a full sound upgrade, every job is done in-house at our Dublin 12 workshop with a factory-style finish. Not sure what you need? Send us your reg and a photo of your dash.
settings.price_note: BMW iDrive 7 video in motion. BMW Apple CarPlay €350, Android radio fitting €150. Other jobs quoted from your reg.
settings.whatsapp_message: Hi MG Car Audio, I'd like a quote. My reg is:

settings.title: Apple CarPlay for BMW
settings.text: Wired or wireless CarPlay on your factory iDrive screen. OEM-style finish, original features kept.

settings.title: BMW Android Auto (iDrive 7)
settings.text: Android Auto switched on for iDrive 7 (ID7) screens. Around an hour in the bay while you wait.

settings.title: Android radio fitting
settings.text: Android head units fitted properly, with neat wiring and a factory-style finish. About 90 minutes.

settings.title: Japanese-to-European conversion
settings.text: Imported BMW? Menus, maps and radio bands switched to European spec. We convert Mercedes-Benz and VW imports too.

settings.title: Screen upgrades
settings.text: Bigger, sharper widescreens for BMW, Mercedes, Audi and VW, with CarPlay and Android Auto built in.

settings.title: Speaker & subwoofer upgrades
settings.text: JBL and Harman Kardon speakers, subs and amps, matched to your car for clear, powerful sound.

settings.title: BMW iDrive 7 video in motion
settings.text: Lets passengers keep watching video on the iDrive 7 screen while the car is moving.

settings.title: Reverse camera fitting
settings.text: A reverse camera that switches on the moment you select reverse, with the wiring hidden. Dashcams hard-wired too.

settings.heading: Popular services
settings.text: Upfront 'from' prices on our most-booked jobs, all fitted at our workshop in Ballymount, Dublin 12. A €50 deposit secures your slot.
settings.footnote: Prices shown are starting prices for fitting at our Dublin 12 workshop. Send us your reg and we'll confirm the exact price for your car before you book.

settings.title: Send your reg + a dash photo
settings.text: WhatsApp us your registration and a quick photo of your dash. That's usually all we need to tell you exactly what fits.

settings.title: Get a fixed quote
settings.text: You get a clear fitted price for parts and labour before you commit. No vague estimates and no surprises on the day.

settings.title: Book a slot
settings.text: Pick a day and time that suits you. A €50 deposit secures your slot at our Ballymount workshop.

settings.title: Drive away
settings.text: We fit it, test everything with your phone and show you how it all works. Most installs take one to two hours.

settings.heading: From your reg to CarPlay in four steps
settings.text: No guesswork and no chasing call-backs. Send us a couple of details and we'll tell you exactly what fits your car, what it costs and when we can fit it.

settings.heading: Not sure what you need?
settings.text: Send your reg and a photo of your dash on WhatsApp. We'll tell you which option suits your car, what it costs and how long the fitting takes.
